name: mutant-census
description: The workspace's quality layer, executed: the burial record's historical defects COMPILED into nine mutation operators (each re-enacting a real error class, provenance on the row), replayed against the shared kernel family and its standard compositions, and KILLED one by one by a ten-property battery that holds for every seeded input (dual-path arithmetic, negative controls, statistical kills labeled DATA-grade). Mutation testing (DEM78, JIA11) and property-based testing (CLA00) are established fields; the claim here is the COUPLING — and, since 0.3.0, the CLOSED LOOP: the burial record is imported LIVE on every run and EVERY error it carries is enrolled to the guard that kills it now (117 on live mutants via a declared-class tie, 306 on build gates anchored file+needle to disk, 221 booked unenforceable with printed reasons) — an error without an enforcement anchor cannot be buried. Since 0.10.0 the BOOKED tier is itself audited data (R-board): every booked reason is refuted or held against the machines that exist now, born-audited at burial time; since 0.11.0 every UPGRADED row carries needle-level firing evidence in the cited gate's own tree (R4, the deep check) and the census's own stated counts are law (E7) — a self-description that drifts from its own arithmetic fails the build; since 0.13.0 the per-error equivalence question is measured on ALL FOUR classes exhaustively (J-board: the ENTIRE 117-row mutation-killed population — nine provenance collapses, every prototype one; twelve error-level kills; TWO PROVEN equivalent specimens of two different species, representation-blind and input-coverage-blind; ninety-four unbuildable). The kernel family's byte-identity across every repo is censused live (unregistered drift fails the build), the repos' engineering hygiene is machine-swept with zero tolerated unguarded entries, and one command (`npm run total`) judges the whole workspace's tests AND typechecks. Since 0.17.0 the identifier-grade citation face is needle-held too (the b55#3 family first pinned to disk: the corrected VDL23 DOI); since 0.18.0 the repro-no-op family is closed at four run-all needles (batch 76 enrolled it systemic: postselect/qram/retro/switch, with a full-workspace audit priced) and the author-table citation face with it; since 0.19.0 the fourth wave's fourteen conviction sites are registered the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 77: readout-wall/survivor-census/ent-clearing/binding-price, two latent v0.1.0 defects among them closed at their own regression needles). since 0.20.0 the fifth wave's ten conviction sites are registered the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 78: qverify/ft-qaoa/choice-lang/vacuum-compiler — two latent v0.1.0 defects among them, the depolarizeQubit branch swap convicted at its new naive-Pauli-conjugation needle and the oldest-first doc face booked, plus two interruption-leftover rows on the b74#6 line); since 0.21.0 the sixth wave's fourteen conviction sites are registered the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 79: dsic-noether/letter-audit/stable-world/dtc-clock, led by TWO SEVERE convictions of previously-shipped dtc-clock claims — the tautologically-verified echo-decay law founding the tautological-witness family with route-price credited as the discovering sibling, and the zetaEM tail-term artifact retiring the Phi1-nonzero reading at a zero-containing bracket — plus one latent v0.2.0 README count-drift row booked on the doc face); since 0.22.0 the census's own RENDERED REPORT is law (S1/S2, the HELD rows' priced refutation targets executed): the board order is legislated and a section-shuffled or row-disordered report is refused BY NAME, and every numeric claim in the rendered prose is reconciled against the live arithmetic on every suite run, the on-disk artifact included — the b36#16/b57#5 prose-drift class, whose first conviction under the law was three phrases already drifted in the shipped prose (ten-vs-seven full members, a four-vs-three family share, and nine/fifteen-vs-eleven/thirty-three audit counts); since 0.23.0 the FINAL wave batch's conviction sites are registered the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 80: wukong-crossval/mutant-census — the version-pin cross-repo family's FOUNDING sighting, a sibling's live-pinned version citation broken by a same-wave upgrade, needle-held at vacuum-compiler's two-ground audit needles; three S2-convicted count-drift rows riding the tamper trials themselves; and S1/S2 registered as firing-inject anchors on their own board); since 0.24.0 the fix-all-errors visit's conviction site is registered the moment the row sat on it (batch 81: the platform CI surface — @types/node 26 adopted at its single unknown-payload breakage gate-held on the platform's format:check anchor, the exit-code-masking family's eleventh and twelfth sightings booked on the shell-act face one visit after the tenth, the sanctioned-channel family's next sighting booked clean-notwithstanding, and TS>=7 dispositioned ecosystem-blocked with the scratch evidence pinned in dependabot's own config); since 0.25.0 the seventh wave's first batch registers its conviction sites the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 82: the four-repo quality wave phase-law/ent-sched/nonstoq-anneal/postselect-sched — postselect's randomSat hang, negative repetitionsFor schedule and NaN binomTailAtMost convicted at ERR.06/ERR.08/ERR.09, phase-law's unwitnessed PL20 cross-check claim wired to a real staircase witness, and the exit-code-masking family's thirteenth plus the sanctioned-channel lineage's eighteenth both booked on their act faces, with the same-wave version-pin re-verification returning clean); since 0.26.0 the quality wave's second batch registers its conviction sites the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 83: the four-repo wave k-switch/causal-ineq/nosignal-tariff/qram-sched — the absorption law's FIRST EXECUTION, its b branch folded into the live tests and its c-class pricing enrolled; qram's six silent-garbage-value paths convicted at their named-code smuggling trials, from the forged undefined pick and the forged empty-index best to the wrong-length mu's NaN amplitudes, the silently dropped out-of-bounds write, the dimension-mismatched NaN linalg solutions and the swallowed OBM read; causal-ineq's silent NaN-grid family convicted at its named-rejection block and its stale duplicate boundaries section deleted at the surviving needle; the exit-code-masking family's fourteenth and fifteenth sightings — the fifteenth the wiring agent's own, one row apart — both booked on the shell-act face, with the same-wave version-pin re-verification returning clean again); since 0.27.0 the quality wave's third batch registers its conviction sites the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 84: the four-repo wave quantum-mech/survivor-census/retro-cache/readout-wall — six latent convictions led by the anchor-blindspot family's HEAVIEST evidence: the transposed dagger2 subscript that broke Y-basis rotations passed all fifty-six tests green and died only at the repro byte-comparison, now held by the Y-basis U-dagger-U both-sides anchor; survivor's silently dropped out-of-range markedB, its divide-by-zero mcWaiting NaN and its message-substring rejection chain convicted at SC/BAD-MARKED, SC/MC-BAD-INPUTS and the code-discrimination starvation trial; retro-cache's NaN printer and its one unguarded public entry convicted at K.G/K.H; quantum-mech's lockfile version residual that outlived a whole version pinned at both slots; the exit-code-masking family's sixteenth and seventeenth attempts booked on the shell-act face one delivery apart, and the family spec trio's death-exit clearance pricing registered pending appeal at the K-board boundary); since 0.28.0 the quality wave's fourth batch registers its conviction sites the moment the rows first sat on them (batch 85: binding-price/ent-clearing/choice-lang/ft-qaoa — fifteen latent conviction sites led by ft-qaoa's nine silent-corrosion entry holes, the 1<<n wraparound class that forged one-entry statevectors and wrapped bit indices among them, beside the market machine's first-cells marginal reader and the board's NaN prose printer, with choice-lang's batch-78 booked doc face REPAID at its E3 needle and the row upgraded under R1; the family register re-synced to the absorption wave's five new divergences — ent-clearing's hardened cmat/states/rng and choice-lang's pared cmat/rng — with re-convergence priced at the appeal court; the sanctioned-channel family's nineteenth through twenty-first sightings and the exit-code-masking family's eighteenth through twenty-first attempts — the last the wiring agent's own — booked on their act faces; the version-pin family's own-repo lockfile face struck three times AT the wiring visit (ft-qaoa's 0.1.0 residual that survived two whole versions, the census's own 0.9.0 that survived nineteen, burial-record's 0.4.0 one behind — all three pinned at live E3 needles, a full-workspace lock sweep priced with fifteen sibling residuals standing). Survivors would be declared SURVIVED and booked as blind spots — a silent survivor is a hidden one.
